subject: delta(client): WF tell a purchase with an unresolved payment to verify it near the delegation end
note: Inside the delegation safety margin, sessionRenewal refuses a purchase whose transfer may already have been sent but is not verified (payment_handoff, broadcast_reported, payment_uncertain: the PAYMENT_OPEN set of seller-session-lifecycle.mjs, now exported) with its own code, seller_delegation_expiring_payment_unresolved, whose text tells the buyer not to pay again or prepare a new purchase but to verify or recover the payment first. A distinct code keeps a host that answers seller_delegation_expiring with a new purchase from inviting a second payment. An unpaid purchase keeps seller_delegation_expiring and its text unchanged. sessionRenewalAccept maps the wire's peer_delegation_expired for a paid (settled_verified) purchase whose delegation expired after the renewal was prepared to the seller_delegation_expired refusal and no-repay text sessionRenewal gives, keeping the wire error as its cause; nothing is saved, and every other acceptance failure is unchanged. Other callers of the margin and the margin constant are unchanged. The README lists both refusals.
